rules.description: Place one queen in every row, every column and every colour region. No two queens may be diagonally adjacent.
rules.regions: regions[r][c] is the colour region id of cell (r, c)
rules.solution: solution[r] is the column of the queen in row r

difficulty.metric: tier-weighted count of the deduction steps needed to solve the board without guessing

guaranteed: solvable by deduction alone, no guessing
